fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic (NASDAQ:ANT) IPO raised $81.3 billion, the largest in history, closing at $97 on the first trading day from the offering price of $83, then declining 9% to around $89 the next day.
fields.summary_ko.1: Historically, among the top 10 IPOs by size, the median within the first year declined 46% from the IPO price, with many closing down 16% by year-end.
fields.summary_ko.2: During the same period, the 10 largest IPO stocks underperformed the S&P 500 (^GSPC) by an average of 48 points, with investors who bought at IPO prices experiencing prolonged losses.
